evidence_required: Written answer (2–5 sentences) that names the mechanism, not just the term.

marking.criterion: Proceed: full bake evidence and no condition breached, with a concrete example
Hold: insufficient evidence (e.g. < 12 samples, telemetry gap), with a concrete example
Abort: pre-declared condition breached (e.g. median busbw drop > 5 %), with a concrete example
States that hold is not abort: no rollback, no progress, a human looks

title: Proceed, hold and abort
